assumes.item: Closure HANDOFF H7, H11 and H15
assumes.assumed: Use the integrator's reconciled working forms for source ranges, lineage, receipt mapping, contextual forms and the 23 final error codes. They are drafts, not owner decisions.
assumes.if_other: Reconcile the consuming descriptions with a revised shared contract. Preserve existing code meanings under ERR.5 and do not infer a model, policy or ADR decision.

assumes.assumed: Describe the uniform logical-step draft lp1-exec-draft-1, its accounting contracts and H6's retained predicate/size agreement. Recorded exact counters remain in reproduction.
assumes.if_other: A fixed-weight schedule needs a different execution identity and compatibility treatment. A change to the exact payload needs an explicit versioned contract; neither alternative is silently selected here.

assumes.assumed: The current renderer draft uses fixed plan ceilings plus the existing output allowance. KN7:budget.display_plan_limit remains reserved, and production limits and measurements remain owed.
assumes.if_other: A separately declared plan allowance needs its own deterministic units and contract before that reserved row can be activated. Fixed ceilings still cannot be reported as exhausted job allowances.

assumes.assumed: Branch-path and void-exit rows describe JI.27/JI.28 and H11 under the working branch form. They supply no branch UI or permission to revive a void exit.
assumes.if_other: Without branches the branch operation is unavailable; the exit/entry, restore and recovery constraints remain. A pinned-job policy change alters lifetimes, not the meaning of these codes.

assumes.assumed: LB6:evidence.decomposition_mismatch describes the conditional native/non-IR tool admission draft. ADR-L07 describes the common IR only under its applicable routes.
assumes.if_other: An IR route uses the common checked-IR obligations; non-IR RT4 still needs its equivalent execution and decomposition evidence. This packet chooses no route or implementation language.

assumes.assumed: ADR-L11 keeps the current chart and renderer-handoff recommendations conditional, with the retained view-placement and design questions open.
assumes.if_other: Built-in-only charts, a user-shader alternative or compatibility with a frozen renderer require their corresponding feature/support contracts and evidence. No renderer, view host or UX is selected here.

assumes.assumed: The 38 closure requirements keep their manifest classes/phases, except CT-EV1-08 and CT-EV2-11 are source requirements in LP4. The 401 imported and 411 combined counts describe this packet's index.
assumes.if_other: The integrator must reconcile additions or changed definitions from the other P7 packets and recount the final combined candidate. An owner-approved phase reorder requires a fresh whole-test readiness check.

owner_items.item: LQ1 to LQ21; ADR-L01, ADR-L02, ADR-L07, ADR-L08 and ADR-L11
owner_items.why: All owner questions and ADR acceptance remain open. Describing a supplied technical draft answers none of them; ADR-L07 remains held for LP1 and the route choice.
The live-turn reading of S4 and replacement of an already presented preview retain their owner/design-line disposition; the freshness and receipt descriptions do not decide them.
Only the owner supplies the product scramble policy. KN5:input.scramble_policy_unset leaves the command unavailable without it.
Both flow-refusal spellings remain reserved until the owner-selected mechanism and joint policy supply their rule and retire one before use.
Numeric production plan ceilings, resource measurements and the recursion guard remain open in their owning contracts. No measured default or new plan allowance is supplied.

owner_items.item: LQ6, LQ7, LQ20 and DT-J2 to DT-J4
owner_items.why: View placement, chart route, renderer handoff and renderer sign-off remain reserved. Pick disambiguation and other UI/UX work stay with the closed design line.

handoff_changes.change: PHS.71 records the 38 known additions and updates this packet's index to 401 imported requirements, or 411 with chapter 12's ten own requirements. Final combined-wave counts remain with the integrator; no handoff form is rejected.
handoff_changes.why: The other five P7 worktrees are not visible here and can add or amend requirement definitions. Their results must be reconciled before final totals or full-wave closure are claimed.
handoff_changes.who: integrator after all P7 packets land

combined_index.given: The base index has 363 imported requirements and this packet adds the 38 named closure requirements.
combined_index.expected: This index has 401 imported requirements: 353 source, 23 synthetic, 11 windows, 9 performance and 5 human. Adding ten CT-PHS source requirements gives 411. A later addition requires a recount before final totals are claimed.

handoff_changes.remaining: Run the aggregate checks on the integrated candidate, compare defining tables with the index under CT-PHS-01, and obtain the packet's post-implementation review. Mechanical checks do not establish semantic correctness or owner acceptance.

contextual_form_row.given: One renderer device is unavailable before publication acceptance, another is lost while an accepted publication is preparing, and a third is lost after that publication installed.
contextual_form_row.expected: All use EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable for the availability failure. Before acceptance its form is refusal with refused(Error); during accepted preparation its form is stop with failed(Error) and an associated job's error(Error); after installation completed(view_published) and all committed mechanical receipts remain unchanged.

registry_rows.given: A branch switch lacks a proved navigation path, a redo would reactivate a known void exit, and an exposed-face request has determined frames but no certified geometry/size profile.
registry_rows.expected: The respective registry rows are KN4:input.branch_path_unproved (store), KN5:input.exit_record_voided (command layer), and KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable (engine). Each is input/refusal with retry after_user_change, names the failed path/void/data fact and preserves the current state. None reports unverified_reference or asks for a missing frame; JI clauses remain rule sources.

branch_path_envelope.given: Target branch B has no proved journal path from the selected head; all frame correspondences are fixed.
branch_path_envelope.expected: KN4:input.branch_path_unproved, category input, origin KN4, form refusal, retry after_user_change; context names B and missing path evidence. Keep the current binding. An explicit validated restore is a separate operation under the exit-void rule.

void_exit_envelope.given: Redo targets entry E whose exit X has a durable void fact V.
void_exit_envelope.expected: KN5:input.exit_record_voided, category input, origin KN5, form refusal, retry after_user_change; context names X and V. Refuse that redo; a fresh validated crossing or solved-witness entry is separate and no frame or equal labels revive X.

exposed_geometry_envelope.given: The request names feature F and fixed exact source binding S, but its certified exposed-face mesh or size profile is absent.
exposed_geometry_envelope.expected: KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable, category input, origin KN2, form refusal, retry after_user_change; context names F, S and the absent data/profile. Report unavailable and fabricate no mesh; do not invent an unresolved correspondence.

phase_index.given: LP2 has its headless interpreter/kernel products but no LP4 module-activation or debugger services; CT-EV1-08 needs an old suspended run across activation and CT-EV2-11 needs stepping across a suspended kernel call.
phase_index.expected: CT-EV1-08 and CT-EV2-11 each occur once in the LP4 source column. Neither occurs in LP2, and an LP2 stub cannot discharge either whole requirement.

X-REG.why_open: All 23 final code rows and all 38 requested phase/class assignments are present. The displayed totals are recomputed for this candidate only; the final full-wave totals and any additions from unseen P7 packets still require integration and recount.
X-REG.who: integrator after the other P7 packets land

all_codes.given: H15.16 takes six final KN names from the eight JI proposals, reuses two existing EV3 codes, adds filter freshness, and imports 16 other codes from p2b, p4 and p5.
all_codes.expected: Exactly 23 new registry rows: EV1:input.module_not_checked, EV1:input.source_range_invalid, EV1:stale.activation_base, EV2:input.word_range_invalid, EV2:stale.debug_stop, KN1:input.unsupported_dimension, KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable, KN2:input.named_object_invalid, KN2:stale.value_unavailable, KN4:input.branch_path_unproved, KN5:input.confirmation_required, KN5:input.exit_record_voided, KN5:input.overlay_dependency_missing, KN5:input.scramble_policy_unset, KN5:resource_limit.engine_lost, KN5:stale.filter_preview, KN5:stale.result_gone, LB1:input.key_contract_mismatch, LB6:evidence.decomposition_mismatch, LG4:input.generator_input, LG4:input.pointwise_failed, LG4:input.text_scalar_invalid, LG4:resource_limit.generator_exhausted. Each has code/category/origin, form, meaning, retry and rule source. JI payload/projection failures reuse EV3:input.display_bundle_mismatch and EV3:input.display_unsupported.

all_requirements.given: Index the closure manifests' 38 requirements, applying RS3-12 to the two full authoring-service tests.
all_requirements.expected: LP1: CT-JI-01 through 07, CT-LI-08, CT-FP-01 through 05, CT-DET-25, CT-LB5-10, CT-LB6-05 and CT-RM-01 (16 source, 1 synthetic). LP2: CT-LI-01 through 07 and CT-DET-26 through 32 (13 source, 1 synthetic). LP3: CT-RM-02 through 06 (3 source, 2 windows). LP4: CT-EV1-08 and CT-EV2-11 (2 source). CT-FP-04 and CT-DET-28 are synthetic; CT-RM-05/06 are windows. Each ID occurs in one phase table, yielding the candidate's 401 imported and 411 combined requirements.

filter_freshness.given: A filter.apply reference was built at state 7 with a resolved filter digest F; the current state is 8 while F is unchanged, and no word preview is pending.
filter_freshness.expected: KN5:stale.filter_preview with category stale, origin KN5, form refusal and retry after_refresh. The submitted filter reference fails H15.4's predicate; a pending word preview or presentation cannot repair it.

display_ceiling_rows.given: A valid publication requests 100 or 101 records against a fixed count ceiling of 100; a different accepted publication needs 101 canonical bytes with 100 output bytes remaining; a third accepted preparation suffers physical allocation failure.
display_ceiling_rows.expected: The fixed-ceiling check admits 100 and refuses 101 before acceptance with EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling and the field/requested/ceiling context. The output case is cut_off(KN7:budget.output) with cancelled(budget), emitting/installing none of the denied unit. Physical failure is failed(KN7:resource_limit.host_exhausted), not a deterministic cut-off. KN7:budget.display_plan_limit stays reserved.

span_units.given: Pinned source has scalars a, U+1F600, U+00E9, LF, z. Host coordinates are declared UTF-16; the requested UTF-8 ranges are [1,5) and [9,9), with invalid UTF-8 or UTF-16 offset 2 as a negative case.
span_units.expected: The shared EV1.10 conversion gives [1,3) and EOF insertion [6,6). Interior offset 2 or an undeclared host unit gives EV1:input.source_range_invalid; a different source digest gives EV1:stale.editor_source. ERR.12 is D and no longer leaves a coordinate choice open.

source_navigation.given: A pick's installed-generation bindings are current, but its pinned producing source digest differs from the source being navigated.
source_navigation.expected: EV3:stale.source_link remains the existing navigation refusal, category stale, origin EV3, retry after_refresh. The registry adds no source-navigation synonym and preserves that code's meaning.

adr_descriptions.given: Read ADR-L01, ADR-L02, ADR-L07, ADR-L08 and ADR-L11 after the closure has supplied KN0.8 freshness, LI receipt/availability protocols, LG4.8/DET.54 to DET.64 execution accounting, and the RM display interface.
adr_descriptions.expected: The descriptions cite those drafts instead of saying the protocols are absent. All five statuses remain Proposed and not accepted, ADR-L07 remains held for LP1 and the route choice, and every record retains its open list and owner alternatives. There is no ADR acceptance, LQ answer, renderer choice or freeze.
